page.layout: One page of verse, one column, with running head at top and page number at top right. Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the right half and is not transcribed.

p.i: Mox pluens pingui rigat imbre campos,
Exitum rebus. Duce te per urbes

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page appears across the right side of the text; not transcribed. Some words in the verse are doubtfully read (e.g. "Fertilis", "Explicet ustas", "Sice", "Sola", "Excitus", "Liberas funima", "Frouidus"); these may be misprints or scan damage. The initial letters of several lines are unclear in the scan, and the long-s forms have been normalised to s.
